rows.name: Merc Group Action

[System:Color name=tutorial ]Merc Group Action[/System:Color] is unlocked.
Control Blades to complete missions.
Start from the [System:Color name=tutorial ]Merc Group menu[/System:Color].

Completing a Merc Group Action mission
also completes its Merc Group mission.

Enemies defeated in Merc Group Action
[System:Color name=tutorial ]do not count[/System:Color] toward quest defeat objectives.
Normal Attacks

Switch Blades using the [System:Color name=tutorial ][ML:icon icon=ZL ] button[/System:Color] and [System:Color name=tutorial ][ML:icon icon=ZR ] button
[/System:Color], or the [System:Color name=tutorial ][ML:icon icon=left ] button[/System:Color] and [System:Color name=tutorial ][ML:icon icon=right ] button[/System:Color].

Press the [System:Color name=tutorial ][ML:icon icon=A ] button[/System:Color] to perform a normal attack.
Keep pressing it to unleash more powerful [System:Color name=tutorial ]combo attacks[/System:Color].
Role Arts

Keep landing normal attacks.
You can then press the [System:Color name=tutorial ][ML:icon icon=B ] button[/System:Color]
to activate [System:Color name=tutorial ]Role Arts[/System:Color].
Using Role Arts creates [System:Color name=tutorial ]Ether Pods[/System:Color] with various bonus effects.
Ether Pods

Attacking or using Role Arts creates [System:Color name=tutorial ]Ether Pods[/System:Color].
Collect them to gain various [System:Color name=tutorial ]bonuses[/System:Color].
They decrease over time, so maintaining them is key.
Red Attack Pods [System:Color name=tutorial ]increase damage dealt[/System:Color].
Blue Armor Pods [System:Color name=tutorial ]reduce damage taken[/System:Color].
Yellow Recast Pods [System:Color name=tutorial ]increase Art recharge speed[/System:Color].
Green Heal Pods [System:Color name=tutorial ]restore a Blade's HP[/System:Color].
Special Arts

[System:Color name=tutorial ]Normal attacks[/System:Color] fill the [System:Color name=tutorial ]Special Gauge[/System:Color],
lighting up character icons as it fills.

When the Special Gauge is full,
press the [System:Color name=tutorial ][ML:icon icon=X ] button[/System:Color] to use a powerful [System:Color name=tutorial ]Special Art[/System:Color].
Fever Time

When the Fever Gauge is full,
press the [ML:icon icon=plus ][System:Color name=tutorial ] button[/System:Color] to activate [System:Color name=tutorial ]Fever Time[/System:Color]!

During Fever Time, [System:Color name=tutorial ]Special Arts recharge faster[/System:Color] and
[System:Color name=tutorial ]attack speed increases[/System:Color], while the [System:Color name=tutorial ]number of Ether Pods[/System:Color] grows.
You can also [System:Color name=tutorial ]knock enemies Down[/System:Color].
Vandham's Guidebook

You can review these explanations at
any time while Merc Group Action is paused.

If you get stuck, try reviewing
what you have learned.
Mission Types

There are several types of missions,
with different completion conditions.
Keep these in mind when forming a team.

[System:Color name=tutorial ]Defeat[/System:Color]: [System:Color name=tutorial ]defeat all enemies[/System:Color].
[System:Color name=tutorial ]Escort[/System:Color]: [System:Color name=tutorial ]protect the target from being destroyed.
Collection[/System:Color]: [System:Color name=tutorial ]collect items by defeating enemies[/System:Color].

Completing the objective of each type
is the condition for clearing the mission.
Field Gimmick

[System:Color name=tutorial ]Field Gimmicks[/System:Color] appear in
Merc Group Action missions.

Activating a Field Gimmick grants various benefits.
They can be activated with [System:Color name=tutorial ]Field Skills[/System:Color],
so consider that when forming your team.
Roles

Blades each have a [System:Color name=tutorial ]Role[/System:Color].
The combination of Roles can greatly change the difficulty.
If you get stuck, try changing your team.

The [System:Color name=tutorial ]Attack Role[/System:Color] has [System:Color name=tutorial ]high offensive power[/System:Color].
It has the highest attack power of any Role
and helps shorten battles.

The [System:Color name=tutorial ]Defense Role[/System:Color] has [System:Color name=tutorial ]high defensive power[/System:Color].
It more easily draws enemy attention,
protecting allies and escort targets.

The [System:Color name=tutorial ]Healing Role[/System:Color] [System:Color name=tutorial ]heals allies' wounds[/System:Color]
and specializes in keeping the team fighting.
Choosing Roles for the mission is key.
Elemental Orbs

Landing Special Arts can attach up to
three [System:Color name=tutorial ]Elemental Orbs[/System:Color] to enemies.

Special Arts can damage Elemental Orbs.
Destroy one to trigger an [System:Color name=tutorial ]Elemental Burst[/System:Color]
and deal even more damage. A Special Art
of the opposite element can [System:Color name=tutorial ]break one in a single hit[/System:Color].

Combining Attack Pods with the
damage bonus from knocking enemies Down
can let you deal enormous damage.
Link Skills

In Merc Group Action battles,
[System:Color name=tutorial ]Link Skills[/System:Color] can activate when
specific pairs are in your team.

You can check which pairs activate
a Link Skill and what it does
when selecting Blades to deploy.
Guard

Press the [System:Color name=tutorial ][ML:icon icon=Y ] button[/System:Color] to [System:Color name=tutorial ]guard[/System:Color].
Guarding [System:Color name=tutorial ]greatly reduces damage taken[/System:Color].
Time it against powerful attacks to fight efficiently.
